messages:
anya (eng): Postmortem posted — root cause: simultaneous token renewals + aggressive model-reg metadata queries hit vendor auth rate limits; our fallback fanout amplified the load. Impact: ~10m errors for hosted-api. doc: https://redwood.in/postmortems/1987654321
max (sre): Timeline: auth 429s started 16:22 UTC, peaked 16:25. KV-cache cold starts made it worse.
leo (vendor-relations): Vendor ticket VEND-2119 opened. They asked for a short trace and request samples. @anya can you attach a 60s trace export?
maria (security): Action: audit rotation jitter and enforce HSM logging for rotates. Owner: maria. ETA: 2026-04-04.
anya (eng): Short-term mitigations: add single-flight token refresh + in-process token cache to avoid parallel refreshes. Owner: anya. ETA: 2026-03-26. I'll attach a safe repro snippet in the postmortem.
prakash (product): Add incident tag "external-auth-throttle" to track recurrence and include in next monthly risk digest. Owner: prakash. ETA: 2026-03-29.
max (sre): Add route-level circuit-breaker on model-reg auth calls and an alert: auth 429/5xx > 3% for 3m -> page oncall. Owner: max. ETA: 2026-03-25.
slo-bot: Incident summary: duration 10m, peak auth fail 76%, hosted-api SLO jitter 0.03%.
leo (vendor-relations): Vendor requests request-id samples and a brief timeline diagram. @anya can you share the 1-min export?
anya (eng): Attached trace to the postmortem and pasted a curl snippet: ```for i in {1..120}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://model-reg.internal/v1/meta & done``` (staging only).
maria (security): Also require runbook PR with KMS rotate steps before any vendor dry-run. I'll open it. ETA: 2026-03-24.
leo (vendor-relations): Proposing a vendor-assisted dry-run (10m token-throttle) to validate circuit-breaker and fallback. Need legal notice. Tentative windows: 2026-04-11 or 2026-04-13.
prakash (product): Prepare customer-facing note for enterprise contacts if we schedule the dry-run. Owner: prakash. ETA: 2026-03-27.
max (sre): I'll draft the ops checklist for the dry-run: 1) vendor notice 2) enable staging throttle 3) enable circuit-breaker 4) run CI harness 5) monitor SLOs.
anya (eng): Ownership recap: max -> circuit-breaker + ops checklist; anya -> token cache + CI harness; maria -> KMS/runbook + audit; leo -> vendor coordination; prakash -> comms + taxonomy.
max (sre): Marking follow-ups in the tracker and will close when PRs merge.
anya (eng): End of thread.
